ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web places Tiger near the top. There is an arrow from Deer pointing into Tiger, showing that deer are a food source for tigers. The diagram also includes other organisms such as plant, goat, snake, eagle, grasshopper, and mynah with arrows showing feeding relationships. Reasoning: The question asks what occurrence would most likely increase the number of tigers over time. In a food web, if a predator has more available prey, its population can increase. Since deer are shown as food for tigers, an increase in deer would most likely lead to an increase in tigers.
